newsitem.title: FINLAND: Chronology of main Helsinki East-West meetings.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of main Helsinki East-West meetings.

text.p: Following are the main East-West meetings in Helsinki's history:
* 1969 SALT nuclear arms reduction talks begin
* 1975 U.S. President Gerald Ford, Soviet leader Leonid Brezhnev and 33 other heads of state sign historic Helsinki Final Act, establishing Conference for Security and Cooperation in Europe -- CSCE
* 1985 U.S. Secretary of State George Schultz and Soviet Foreign Minister Eduard Shevardnadze hold first meeting; foreign ministers gather for CSCE 10th anniversary
* 1988 U.S. President Ronald Reagan visits briefly on the way to Moscow
* 1990 U.S. President George Bush and Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev hold summit
* 1992 CSCE foreign ministers joined by their counterparts from central and east European states who add their names to Helsinki Final Act
* 1996 Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov and U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher hold first meeting.
